headline: Shrirampps Q2 net profit more than doubles YoY
summary: Shrirampps reported a consolidated net profit of 216 million rupees in Q2, up from 86 million rupees in the same period last year, while revenue fell to 1.84 billion rupees from 2 billion rupees.

headline: Globe Civil Projects Q2FY27: Revenue up 30% YoY
summary: Globe Civil Projects reported a 30.6% YoY rise in standalone revenue to ₹1,147.5 million for Q2FY27, though net profit declined 36% QoQ.

headline: Biocon gets US FDA nod for breast cancer biosimilar
summary: Biocon Limited received U.S. FDA approval for Pebrilzo, a biosimilar to Perjeta for HER2-positive breast cancer. This marks its fifth oncology biosimilar in the US, with commercial launch expected in Q3 2028.

headline: Glenmark launches generic Axitinib in US
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA launched authorized generic Axitinib tablets, targeting a market with $538.4 million annual sales.

headline: ABB India: Motilal Oswal upgrades to Buy
summary: Motilal Oswal upgrades ABB India to Buy with a target of ₹8,200, citing 56% YoY order inflow growth. HSBC maintains Reduce rating at ₹5,400 amid margin contraction.

headline: Goldman Sachs holds Neutral on Ashok Leyland, target ₹152
summary: Goldman Sachs maintains a Neutral rating on Ashok Leyland with a target price of ₹152. Q2 revenue and PAT were broadly in line with estimates, with revenue and EBITDA growing 39% and 16% YoY respectively.

headline: CLSA cuts Tata Motors target price to ₹369
summary: CLSA maintains Outperform on Tata Motors but cuts target price to ₹369. JLR Q2 EBIT margin fell 166 bps QoQ to 1.1%, with FY27 guidance cut to 2-3% EBIT margin.

headline: Kalpataru Projects secures new order worth ₹2,610 crore
summary: Kalpataru Projects International has secured a new order worth ₹2,610 crore, marking a significant contract win for the infrastructure company.

headline: Sun Pharma plans $4 billion loan to refinance Organon deal
summary: Sun Pharma plans a $4 billion loan with five banks to refinance part of the bridge financing arranged for its $11.75 billion acquisition of Organon.

headline: RBI flags microfinance pricing and recovery concerns
summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised concerns over pricing practices and recovery methods in microfinance, while rejecting demands to ease credit assessment norms for microfinance institutions.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins ₹362.85 crore wagon order
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹362.85 crore order from IVC Logistics for the supply of 464 wagons, marking a significant contract win for the company.

headline: India eyes local gold mining to cut import reliance
summary: The government aims to boost domestic gold mining through improved geological data, incentives, and private sector participation to reduce India's dependence on gold imports.

headline: Finance Ministry eyes standard customs rules for BESS
summary: The Finance Ministry may establish standard customs rules for battery energy storage projects to reduce import duty and GST costs, currently estimated at approximately 31%.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2959%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.2959% from the previous close of 7.3079%, reflecting a marginal easing in sovereign borrowing costs.

headline: Tata Steel plans merger with Neelachal Ispat by FY27
summary: Tata Steel plans to finalize its merger with Neelachal Ispat Nigam Ltd by the end of FY27, aiming to enhance operations and business integration.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 94.2075 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 94.2075 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 94.21, reflecting a marginal movement in the domestic currency.

headline: Dharti Proteins approves 1:1 bonus share allotment
summary: Dharti Proteins Limited approved the allotment of 75,000 bonus equity shares in a 1:1 ratio for non-promoter members. The record date was November 13, 2026.

headline: Max Healthcare shares flag large trade at ₹975.20
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,40,662 Max Healthcare shares at ₹975.20 on NSE, with a combined value of ₹23.47 crore. Not a confirmed exchange deal.

headline: HGS signs 3-year deal with Rackspace
summary: Hinduja Global Solutions enters three-year partnership with Rackspace Technology for global engineering and digital capabilities, enhancing AI infrastructure services.

headline: Mayank Cattle Food expands retail network in Gujarat
summary: Mayank Cattle Food Ltd signs MOUs to open 11 new retail stores in Gujarat, marking its strategic entry into the retail segment to enhance brand visibility and revenue streams.

headline: Brightcom Q2FY27: PAT up 13.7% YoY
summary: Brightcom Group reported a 13.70% YoY rise in Q2 PAT to ₹264.96 crore, with revenue growing 17.38% to ₹1,937.04 crore.

headline: AIA Engineering shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,50,259 AIA Engineering shares changing hands on BSE at ₹3,170.00, with a combined value of ₹47.63 crore.

headline: Kinetic Engineering Q2FY27 Results
summary: Kinetic Engineering reports 99% YoY consolidated revenue growth to ₹78.31 crore. Standalone PAT turns positive at ₹0.44 crore, reversing prior quarter loss.

headline: Aartech Solonics Q2FY27 results
summary: Aartech Solonics reports Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹1.24 lakh, down 13% YoY, despite revenue growth to ₹1,260.50 lakh.

headline: Nath Bio-Genes H1FY27 revenue up 13%, PAT down 18%
summary: Nath Bio-Genes reported a 13% YoY rise in H1FY27 revenue to ₹3,601 Mn. However, EBITDA fell 11% and PAT declined 18% due to margin compression and higher finance costs.
